;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**Around 20,000 [[Palestinians]] protest near the [[Israel–Gaza barrier]]. Medical sources say that [[Israel Defense Forces]] killed two people and wounded at least 270 others, 50 of them with live bullets. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-violence/israeli-troops-kill-two-palestinians-in-gaza-border-protests-medics-idUSKBN1L21WR (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[XiamenAir Flight 8667]]
**A [[Boeing 737]] skids off a runway at [[Ninoy Aquino International Airport]], [[Philippines]], while landing in a downpour. All aboard are unharmed but the aircraft is severely damaged with one engine and some of the landing gear being ripped away. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2018/08/16/chinese-plane-skids-off-manila-runway-in-downpour-all-safe.amp.html (Fox News)]

;International relations
*[[United States foreign policy in the Middle East]], [[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[United States Department of State|U.S. Department of State]] announces that it will redirect approximately [[United States dollar|US$]]230 million in stabilization funds for [[Syria]] to "other key foreign policy priorities." [[List of United States Foreign Service Career Ambassadors|Career Ambassador]] [[James Franklin Jeffrey|James Jeffrey]] is appointed as "special representative for Syrian engagement". [https://www.chron.com/news/article/APNewsBreak-AP-Sources-US-ends-Syria-13163336.php (AP via Chron)]

;Law and crime
*A high court in [[İzmir]], [[Turkey]], rejects an appeal to release [[United States|U.S.]] pastor [[Andrew Brunson]]. [https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2018/08/17/u-s-pastor-turkish-court-rejects-freedom-cleric-backed-trump/1017464002/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[Amnesty International]] releases a report accusing [[Indonesia]]n police of fatally shooting at least 77 suspected [[Misdemeanor|petty criminals]] since January 2018, in the lead-up to the [[2018 Asian Games]]. Authorities insist that lethal force is used when the suspects resist the police. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45223495 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Pakistani general election, 2018]]
**[[Imran Khan]], the chairman of the [[Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf|Tehreek-e-Insaf]] (PTI) party, is elected as the [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Prime Minister]] of [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/08/imran-khan-elected-pakistan-prime-minister-180817074849200.html (Al Jazeera)]
